Shaped iteration 0125 as one `benchmark/default/high` task, limited to 120 minutes and 80 turns.
[Task graph](tasks.json) prepares new WP1 narrative-adjudication challenges and preserves the exact #594 review artifact.
[Review #594](reports/594.json) is Standards CLEAR / Spec CLEAR for the pinned conditional incorporation only; that scope is closed.
Historical F4 slots and general established-key/full-trial use remain blocked; no unchanged review is ordered.
The next concrete gap is C1: structured controls do not establish semantic equivalence, completeness, extras, contradictions or citation support for future prose.
New raw cases, separate authored expectations and an adjudicator procedure will make that gap testable in a separate session.
The task requires observed findings before authoring and preserves source obligations without modifying existing benchmark files.
Its repository-only verification command checks integrity and focused rejections; it does not certify narrative truth.
No session can run LabVIEW. Human/native/trial evidence, method acceptance and benchmark readiness remain unresolved.
[Working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) records the closed scope, artifact pins, remaining gaps and resume instructions.
Startup diagnostics were ok; graph and report were checked by readback with the available role tools. No shell checks were run.

## What next
Execute the graph, then independently check the new challenge package with source-derived judgments saved before expectation-bearing reads.
If execution is partial, resume its saved branch/tag and complete only the missing piece; do not replay #594 or historical probes.
